note: The one Fatline launchpad and the one Fatliners contract, on Base. Every Fatline server, client and hatchery reads these unless its config says otherwise.

AppFactory.rules: Coins only for hatched Fatliners, one each (at most 777). $FATLINE first. The coin's symbol must be the Fatliner's surname. 100% of fees to its vault, in USDC.

Fatliners.rules: Eggs: unlimited, one per FID, can't be moved (takeEgg). Fatliners: hatched from an egg (hatch), at most 777, transferable. Attesters: servers that hatched; 3 signatures (or all, while fewer).
